name: Touhou Emblem
storyline: Reimu and Marisa set out to unify Gensokyo amid incidents spanning iconic Touhou locales; mid-game branches lead to alternative late chapters (e.g., Buddhist vs. Taoist routes) before converging on the finale.
summary: Fan-made crossover tactical RPG built as a Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones ROM hack, bringing Touhou Project characters, music, and locations to a 26-chapter campaign with a mini route split. Play classic grid-based, turn-based battles with Touhou units across areas like Scarlet Devil Mansion, Netherworld, and Former Hell, released as a free digital fangame via FEU.
